q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an aluminium beverage can?
title: Aluminium can carbon footprint per can
short: Most of a can's footprint is its aluminium: multiply the can and end weight by the coil supplier's per-kg figure, then add forming, washing, coating and curing energy. Divide the plant's energy by cans made and name the recycled share.

ul: Aluminium coil for the body and end.
Scrap returned to the coil supplier.

p: Report per can by size. Recycled aluminium carries a much lower per-kg figure than primary metal.

example.title: Worked example: aluminium can unit per can (one month)
lines: Plant total: 306,000 / 20,000,000 = 0.0153 kg CO2 per can
Add aluminium for the full figure

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
